about_the_game:
Take your favorite songs and turn them into an electrifying, music-driven adventure! This innovative rhythm game transforms any track you import into a visually stunning, procedurally generated road where every beat shapes the challenge. Soar through vibrant landscapes, collect notes in sync with the music, and experience a fusion of sound, speed, and style like never before.

Key Features

  • Play Any Song – Import your own music files, and let the game craft a unique level just for you!

  • Dynamic Music Analysis – The game detects beats, notes, and BPM to ensure precise rhythm-based gameplay.

  • Procedural Track Generation – Every song creates a one-of-a-kind road, adapting to its energy and volume dynamics.

  • Rhythm-Powered Gameplay – Glide along the track, hit notes in sync with the beat, and dodge obstacles to stay in the groove.

  • Disco Lights & Mesmerizing Effects – Experience pulsating neon visuals that react to the music, bringing every song to life.

  • Compete on Leaderboards – Climb the online leaderboards for any song and prove your rhythm mastery.

  • Level Editor & Steam Workshop Support – Customize, share, and play community-created tracks with infinite replayability!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti / RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card

short_description: A rhythm-based music game where you import your own tracks to generate unique, dynamic roads. Collect notes in sync with the beat, dodge obstacles, and experience dazzling visuals.
